name: homolyze
stdout:
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
homolyze  monad ⋈ the_stone — the radical-generating reverse of click
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  the monad—the_stone σ-bond: a click on R↔S (Δ=1.33) — a shared electron pair, the reaction center.
  → homolysis splits that pair EVENLY (δ_A): each fragment keeps ONE electron — the SOMO:
      monad•  ⟨𐑼𐑶𐑽𐑬𐑐𐑧𐑲𐑝⊙𐑓𐑳𐑷⟩   neutral radical — SOMO open on R↔S, seeks a partner  [⊡=𐑷 even — SOMO is the opened bond center]
      the_stone•  ⟨𐑦𐑸𐑾𐑹𐑐𐑧𐑲𐑠⊙𐑫𐑙𐑭⟩   neutral radical — SOMO open on R↔S  [⊡=𐑭 even — SOMO is the opened bond center]
  recombination (μ): monad• + the_stone• → monad—the_stone  — radical coupling re-pairs the SOMO (μ∘δ=id, lossless).
  heterolytic alternative (δ_D → ion pair): the same bond can break UNEVENLY — one fragment takes both
    electrons (anion), the other none (cation): the single-electron / radical-ion route — `./ask --set monad the_stone` → monad•⁺ / the_stone•⁻.
